decisions.reason: A niche agricultural harvesting crate costs little to carry in an existing injection-molding portfolio, and with no evidence after 2019 its option value remains unresolved.
The foldable large container had its own page in both years, signaling strong commitment in a growth segment of reusable logistics, so the option still looks valuable.
A standard stackable crate is core catalog business with low carrying cost, so keeping it is cheap while demand is uncertain.
A medium-duty rackable pallet fits the firm's core pallet range and costs little to keep listed, which justifies holding the option.
The spill-retention pallet was downgraded from its own page to a mention, a weak signal of fading value, but the low carrying cost still favors keeping it for now.
The pallet with load retainers also lost its dedicated page, suggesting less emphasis, yet as a variant of an existing pallet it remains cheap to keep while uncertainty lasts.
